k-anthropic.title: Anthropic IPO runner coins ($AI, $ANT)
k-anthropic.sourceSays: Posts say Anthropic's IPO is imminent with no memecoin 'runner' yet; one account points to a crypto easter egg in Anthropic's GitHub and another asks for a Dario Amodei coin. Unverified.
k-anthropic.reason: Posts of Nov 18 describe traders hunting for an Anthropic IPO memecoin runner; Anthropic's own Nov 12 post confirms the IPO. Coins opened about an hour before; the claim that any coin is official is unverified.

k-sym-ANT.reason: $ANT posts are about Anthropic's Nasdaq ticker, not the 'All Natural Tits' coins sharing the symbol; a ticker collision with no story behind the coins themselves.
